# Kaiser CX

> Kaiser CX is a Berlin-based consultancy led by Christiane Kaiser. It helps Customer Success and operations teams turn expert judgement into AI-supported decision making, using the technology they already have (e.g. HubSpot), and offers interim leadership for business and customer operations.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://kaiser-cx.com/): what Kaiser CX does, where it pays off, how to start
- [Christiane Kaiser](https://kaiser-cx.com/christiane-kaiser.html): profile, services (interim leadership, business and customer operations, AI-enabled process transformation), how she works, client recommendation
- [Insights](https://kaiser-cx.com/insights.html): case study, whitepaper, articles, newsletter
- [Rail-Flow case study](https://kaiser-cx.com/rail-flow-case-study.html): 16-week Customer Success foundation project, from spreadsheet to structured HubSpot data and an AI-assisted signal layer
- [Whitepaper: From Signal to Action](https://kaiser-cx.com/from-signal-to-action.html): why churn is a timing problem and what Agentic AI changes (with Pollup AI)

## Facts
- Founder: Christiane Kaiser, 15+ years in B2B SaaS, almost 10 years leading international Customer Success teams across EMEA, formerly Brandwatch
- Location: Berlin, Germany; works across Germany and internationally
- Contact: christiane@kaiser-cx.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/christiane-kaiser-9a90207
- Implementation partner for AI automation: Pollup AI (https://pollup.ai)
